item.title: Helium-Neon Lasers from First Principles
item.description: The helium-neon laser is the most elegant gas laser ever engineered. It produces a continuous, stable, nearly perfect Gaussian beam using nothing more than a tube of gas, two mirrors, and a high-voltage discharge.

item.title: C++26 Static Reflection: What P2996 Actually Gives Us
Init Systems, Daemon Spawning, and the Performance Cost of Process Management
item.description: Most of us type systemctl start myservice and move on. The service starts, it runs in the background, it restarts if it crashes. We don’t think about what’s happening underneath because systemd has made daemon management feel trivial.

item.title: mRNA Vaccines: From Immunological Curiosity to Pandemic Countermeasure
item.description: The development of mRNA vaccines against SARS-CoV-2 is often presented as an overnight success. It wasn’t. The core platform rested on decades of work solving fundamental problems in RNA biochemistry, innate immune evasion, lipid nanoparticle formulation, and antigen design.
